target: aggregated (PATO_0001629; RELATED synonym clustered); '3-5-clustered' is a count of the parts per cluster (pattern 03)
reason: A quality of the arrangement of flowers, leaves etc., not a structure; 'en touffe', 'in clusters of' likewise. FLOPO:0991098 fascicled also exists for clusters from one point.

Same as 'lateral lobe', rejected on 2026-11-13: generic part, needs the organ it belongs to (labellum, corolla, leaf, rostellum...). Where the organ is named, its lobe class (labellum lobe FLOPO_0986028, corolla lobe FLOPO_0986006, leaf lamina lobe PO_0025517) takes the statement.

target: basal axillary shoot system (PO_0005001)
reason: Narrower: an offset is a short lateral shoot from the base of a rosette plant or bulb that roots and forms a new plant. PO_0005001 is an axillary shoot system that is part of the stem base, with tiller and ratoon as synonyms. Fall back to axillary shoot system PO_0006343 if a flora uses it for non-basal shoots.

label: rostellum lobe
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of FLOPO_0986017 (rostellum)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) that is one of the divisions of a lobed rostellum (FLOPO:0986017) of an orchid flower, such as the side lobes or arms of the rostellum in Habenaria.
reason: Modelled on stigma lobe, labellum lobe and corona lobe (2026-11-13). The bare word 'lobe' is rejected, and no generic lobe class exists for non-phyllome organs. 5 floras. Propose to PO together with rostellum, not on its own.

target: involucral bract (PO_0009045)
reason: Narrower: the leaf-like bracts of the involucre below an umbel-like inflorescence (Cyperaceae, Euphorbia, Apiaceae). PO_0009045 is an inflorescence bract of an involucre, which covers them.

target: viscidium (FLOPO_0986032)
reason: Exact: plural of viscidium; the FLOPO class was added on 2026-11-13.

An alternative of two generic parts ('2-6 teeth or lobes'), with no organ named; tooth and lobe alone need the organ they belong to. Where the organ is named, count with pattern 03 on its lobe or tooth class.

label: staminate zone of inflorescence
definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is the portion of an inflorescence (PO:0009049), such as a spadix (PO:0030120) or a spike, that bears only staminate flowers, as in Araceae and Typha.
reason: A real region measured in length and diameter (Typha spikes, aroid spadices); 'fertile/sterile staminate portion' are its kinds. No PO class for the zones of a spadix or spike; modelled on spadix appendix FLOPO_0986049. Pattern 12 (part of a qualified whole) cannot express a region of an axis defined by its flowers. Propose to PO with the other spadix zones.

target: leaf lamina lobe (PO_0025517)
reason: Narrower: a segment is a deeply cut lobe of a divided blade. PO's lobe is defined by a sinus of at least a quarter of the way to the axis, with no upper limit, so it covers segments. Same target as 'leaf lobe' (reviewed 2026-09-18).

target: rule:entity_presence: portion of secretory tissue (PO_0005656) present (as rule C265 gland); or glandular PATO_0002117
reason: A quality of the bearer (having glands), not a structure.

target: stigma lobe (FLOPO_0986009)
reason: Exact: the adjective form of stigma lobe.

target: pattern 10 (ratio to another part), with the tube of the organ as the second term
reason: A ratio phrase ('2-3 times as long as the tube'), not a structure; as 'times calyx' and 'times width' (rejected 2026-11-13).

target: leaf lamina vein (PO_0020138)
reason: Narrower: veins arising from the base of the lamina; same target as 'basal vein' (C272). '5-7-nerved from the base' is a count of these veins (pattern 03).

label: hastula
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of PO_0009025 (vascular leaf)
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a vascular leaf (PO:0009025) that is a flap, crest or ridge of tissue at the junction of the petiole (PO:0020038) and the leaf lamina (PO:0020039), on the adaxial or abaxial side, as in palmate and costapalmate leaves of Arecaceae.
reason: A distinct palm structure described with its own shape, margin and texture in 5 floras; PO has no class. Should be proposed to PO upstream.
Generic part (folds), needs the organ it belongs to; 'fold' was rejected on 2026-11-13. '4-6-plicate' is a count of folds of a named organ (pattern 03) or the quality plicate (PATO_0104365).

target: leaf (PO_0025034), with the context word 'stem' giving cauline (FLOPO_0991117)
reason: Narrower. Many statements are about moss (Sphagnum) stem leaves, and cauline leaf PO_0000013 is defined as a vascular leaf, so leaf PO_0025034 plus the existing 'stem' context word covers both mosses and vascular plants. This differs from C384 ('stem leave' → PO_0000013), which should be aligned.
Generic part, needs the organ it belongs to (here the hyaline cells of Sphagnum leaves); 'pore' was rejected on 2026-11-13.

target: count per unit (pattern 03), with leaf axil (PO_0009023) as the unit
reason: A count phrase ('1-3 per leaf axil'), not the part described; 'per axil' and 'per node' were rejected on 2026-11-13.

Ambiguous: in rattans a whip-like sterile inflorescence on the leaf sheath ('to 2 m long, armed with hooks'), in mosses a thin branch ('root-like flagellums'), elsewhere a whip-like tip. A rattan flagellum class may be worth adding later with a palm-only context rule.

target: female (PATO_0000383), with the elided bearer (flower, inflorescence) from the context rule
reason: A sex quality with its noun left out ('1 ou 3 fleurs ♀', '56-183 ♀'); already a context word in config/flora_context_words.tsv.

target: leaf apex (PO_0020137)
reason: Narrower: the hair-like, often hyaline tip of a moss leaf; PO_0020137 has 'phyllid apex' as a synonym. 'ending in a hair-point' is the leaf apex with a filiform shape.

target: hermaphrodite (PATO_0001340), with the elided bearer (flower, floret)
reason: A sex quality with its noun left out ('bisexual 18-25', 'Bisexual florets ca. 5').

target: count of leaf (PO_0025034) per whorl (pattern 03); arrangement whorled (PATO_0001951)
reason: A count phrase, not a structure; 'per whorl' was rejected on 2026-11-13.

target: leaf lamina (PO_0020039)
reason: Narrower: in moss descriptions the limb is the blade above the sheathing base ('reflexed at the shoulders'). The bare word 'limb' stays rejected.

Generic and mixed: fruit hooks ('hooks per keel'), axillary hooks that are modified branches or inflorescences ('crochets axillaires'), prickles. PO's apical hook (PO_0000012) is the seedling hypocotyl hook and does not apply.

target: fruit (PO_0009001): counts as pattern 03 (lobe of the fruit, 'only 1-3 lobes developing'); shapes on the lobe as a region of the fruit
reason: The lobes are the carpel units of a lobed fruit (Sapindaceae, Euphorbiaceae, Ochnaceae). PO has no fruit lobe, and they are not always mericarps (PO_0020075) or monocarps, so I do not map them to either.

target: peristome tooth (PO_0030043)
reason: Exact: plural of the PO label.

target: rule:entity_presence: stalk (PO_0025066) present (stipe → stalk, rule C264); 'stipitate glands' → FLOPO_0991172 stipitate-glandular
reason: A quality (having a stipe), not a structure; 'with a stipe 2 mm' is a measurement of the stalk.

target: second order inflorescence axis (PO_0006321)
reason: Narrower: the first-order branches of an umbel or umbel-like inflorescence (Euphorbia, Cyperaceae, Apiaceae); PO_0006321 has 'primary inflorescence branch' as a synonym.

target: distant (FLOPO_0991189) for 'widely spaced'; count of pairs as pattern 03
reason: A quality of the arrangement ('widely spaced pairs'), not a structure. 'evenly spaced' has no term and stays unmapped.
